cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll help finish the furniture sale. Sofa goes, but before we decide about my chair, tell me why you've kept it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody offered anything. Did you bring its cushion back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought it. I'll do the lifting; you only need to decide this: if someone offered twenty pounds, would you keep the chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I like pretending you're about to sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll admit I sleep with the cushion. Chair stays; I'll take its sticker off, if that's all right. You decide where it goes. Could we put the cushion back while I'm sitting in it?

reason: Give A a confident sorting role that yields effort and placement while using a sale decision to elicit B longing before revealing the cushion attachment.
